independence.method: Independent HarfBuzz shape metrics, fontTools table comparison, actual FreeType raster proofs inspected with view_image. Fixed 189-codepoint scope accepted.

ui.reason: Numeric UI at weight 400–700, opsz 9–14 is clear; tnum stabilizes timers and right-aligned fixed-precision numbers. Do not use weight 100 at 16px for critical values.

headings.reason: 32px numeric samples are legible across sampled axes; thin 100/128 has low emphasis and must suit contrast and size.

body.reason: Inline currency and decimals at 16px, usual axes are legible. This review does not assess full prose.

sustained_reading.reason: Numeric samples cannot establish long-form reading comfort.

findings.condition: Live numeric widgets using default/pnum rather than tnum: default digits are proportional at all nine sampled locations. At 100/9, digit 1 advances 434 versus 0 639 normalized units.
findings.recommendation: Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for timers, counters and numeric tables, and right-align equal-precision amounts. This is integration guidance, not a font defect.
findings.acceptance_test: At fixed axes, cycle the six tested HH:MM:SS values and confirm invariant text width; right-align 1.11,12.34,123.45,1234.56 and confirm equal decimal x positions.

findings.condition: Weight 100 at 16px, especially opsz128, renders low-contrast hairline numerals and fine punctuation in the inspected proof.
findings.recommendation: Keep critical numeric UI near weight400–700 and optical sizes9–14; reserve the thin display extreme for larger decorative values.
findings.acceptance_test: Review timers/currency at actual 1x and 2x device rendering with intended contrast; distinguish all digits and decimal/colon marks without zoom.

positive_findings: All 18 tnum conditions have equal digit advances and stable timer widths.
calt substitutes raised numeric colon without changing advance; at400/14 its top is604 and bottom101 versus text colon500/-4 (1000-unit normalized).
Decimal periods stay at baseline; currency marks and mathematical minus are present and distinguishable in examined specimens.
WOFF2 relevant outlines, metrics and layout tables match TTF.
limits: Bounded expert screening, not a reader study.
No browser/OS hinting or live UI integration assessment.
No claim that tnum aligns decimals with unequal fractional precision, currency prefix width or absent right alignment.
All rendered rows use calt on; calt off was checked in metrics.
Visual proof contains numeral samples, not sustained prose.
